// loops: every range form the language iterates: a string by rune, a
// map by key and value with order-independent assertions, iterator
// funcs through their yield, and channels drained to their close.
// break exits the innermost loop and continue skips the rest of an
// iteration; without conditions both fire on the first pass, which is
// what the counters observe.
buf := bytes.NewBufferString("");
for i, r := range "ab£" {
	buf.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%d:%c ", i, r));
}
assert.Equal(tb, "0:a 1:b 2:£ ", buf.String());

m := sizes();
kc := counter();
for k, v := range m {
	kc.Add(strlen(k));
	kc.Add(v);
}
assert.Equal(tb, 20, kc.Sum());

lines := bytes.NewBufferString("");
skips := counter();
for line := range strings.Lines("one\ntwo\n") {
	lines.WriteString(line);
	continue;
	skips.Add(100);
}
assert.Equal(tb, "one\ntwo\n", lines.String());
assert.Equal(tb, 0, skips.Sum());

parts := strings.Fields("a b c");
pos := bytes.NewBufferString("");
for i, s := range slices.All(parts) {
	pos.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%d%s", i, s));
}
assert.Equal(tb, "0a1b2c", pos.String());

ch := closedChanOf("x", "y", "z");
got := bytes.NewBufferString("");
for s2 := range ch {
	got.WriteString(s2);
}
assert.Equal(tb, "xyz", got.String());

bc := counter();
for range m {
	bc.Add(1);
	break;
}
assert.Equal(tb, 1, bc.Sum());

oc := counter();
for range 3 {
	for range 5 {
		oc.Add(1);
		break;
	}
}
assert.Equal(tb, 3, oc.Sum());

ch2 := closedChanOf("p", "q");
for range ch2 {
	break;
}
rest := <-ch2;
assert.Equal(tb, "q", rest);
